bibliography.title: Mathematical Games: the fantastic combinations of Conway’s game Life
bibliography.finding: Local binary updates can sustain recognizable moving or recurring configurations.
bibliography.application: Use explicit neighborhoods and reproducible rules. Conway Life is 2D B3/S23; the implemented 3D B6/S567 rule is a different model.

bibliography.title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
bibliography.finding: Reaction and diffusion can destabilize a homogeneous state under specified conditions.
bibliography.application: Separate a mechanism from a visual resemblance. Spotted output alone does not identify a Turing instability.

bibliography.title: An Outline of General System Theory
bibliography.finding: Relations and system organization motivate principles that cross disciplinary boundaries.
bibliography.application: Model boundaries and whole/part relations explicitly; analogies do not establish identical mechanisms.

bibliography.title: The Theory of Open Systems in Physics and Biology
bibliography.finding: Foundational treatment of open systems.
bibliography.application: Use the publication as historical grounding; distinguish a module receiving inputs from a globally autonomous simulation. Detailed claims require the full paper.

bibliography.title: Computational Systems Biology
bibliography.finding: Computational and experimental approaches are combined to study biological systems.
bibliography.application: Connect model building to hypothesis testing. Bits and network edges do not supply metabolism, division or validated biological chemistry.

bibliography.title: Computational Approaches to Cellular Rhythms
bibliography.finding: Models connect feedback and biochemical mechanisms to cellular rhythms.
bibliography.application: Study oscillator coupling and regulation, while treating biological correspondence as a separate validation task.

bibliography.title: Between Order and Chaos
bibliography.finding: Information and computation offer tools for studying structured complexity.
bibliography.application: Avoid equating entropy, randomness or visual detail with useful organization; measure more than one aspect.

bibliography.title: Computation at the Edge of Chaos
bibliography.finding: Cellular automata were used to investigate relations between dynamics and computational behavior.
bibliography.application: Treat criticality as a model-dependent hypothesis rather than a universal design target.

bibliography.title: Dynamics, Computation, and the Edge of Chaos: A Re-Examination
bibliography.finding: Re-examines proposed links between cellular-automaton dynamics and computation.
bibliography.application: Include counterevidence and avoid promising complexity at a special parameter boundary.

bibliography.title: Weak Emergence
bibliography.finding: Distinguishes a simulation-based conception of weak emergence.
bibliography.application: Use a defined notion of emergence. A finite demonstration does not prove the absence of every explanatory shortcut.

bibliography.title: Measuring Emergence via Nonlinear Granger Causality
bibliography.finding: Proposes prediction-based dependence and autonomy relative to chosen micro/macro descriptions.
bibliography.application: A possible future measure requiring explicit variables and validated predictive models; current Hamming comparisons are not this measure.

bibliography.title: Quantifying Causal Emergence Shows That Macro Can Beat Micro
bibliography.access: Primary article abstract; intermittent full-text access
bibliography.finding: Compares causal models at micro and macro scales using effective information.
bibliography.application: Requires an intervention distribution and coarse-graining. The app does not currently compute effective information.

bibliography.title: Complex Patterns in a Simple System
bibliography.finding: A simple reaction–diffusion model exhibits varied spatiotemporal patterns.
bibliography.application: Use Gray–Scott as a parameterized model family; this coarse clamped 3D solver is not a reproduction of the original simulations.

bibliography.title: Testing Turing’s Theory of Morphogenesis in Chemical Cells
bibliography.finding: Synthetic chemical-cell experiments test reaction–diffusion predictions under controlled conditions.
bibliography.application: The experimental comparison illustrates why model-specific measurements matter more than resemblance.

bibliography.title: The Theory of Pattern Formation on Directed Networks
bibliography.finding: Directed topology can change the conditions for pattern-forming instabilities.
bibliography.application: Distinguish embedding geometry from network topology. Current app links are not automatically this paper’s reaction–diffusion operator.

bibliography.title: Combining Turing and 3D Vertex Models Reproduces Autonomous Multicellular Morphogenesis with Undulation, Tubulation, and Branching
bibliography.finding: Combines chemical patterning with deforming multicellular geometry in three dimensions.
bibliography.application: A fixed voxel cube omits the mechanical geometry and growth in that model; do not claim tissue morphogenesis.

bibliography.title: Lenia: Biology of Artificial Life
bibliography.finding: Continuous cellular automata support diverse organized patterns under generalized local rules.
bibliography.application: Useful future algorithm family; Lenia and its published organisms are not currently implemented.

bibliography.title: Lenia and Expanded Universe
bibliography.finding: Extends Lenia across dimensions, kernels and channels.
bibliography.application: Dimensions and channels are independent design axes; added axes alone do not guarantee greater organization.

bibliography.title: How Long Is the Coast of Britain? Statistical Self-Similarity and Fractional Dimension
bibliography.finding: Scale-dependent measurement and statistical self-similarity motivate fractional-dimension descriptions.
bibliography.application: Fractal claims need a scaling range. Four coarse box widths in a 10-cell edge are not an asymptotic dimension estimate.

bibliography.title: Place Illusion and Plausibility Can Lead to Realistic Behaviour in Immersive Virtual Environments
bibliography.finding: Distinguishes aspects of experienced presence in immersive environments.
bibliography.application: Presence is an observer property, not proof that simulated patterns have additional physical reality.

bibliography.title: A Separate Reality: An Update on Place Illusion and Plausibility in Virtual Reality
bibliography.finding: Reviews presence concepts, measurement approaches and unresolved questions.
bibliography.application: Evaluate the viewing experience separately from the accuracy of the underlying simulation.

bibliography.title: Immersive Analytics with Abstract 3D Visualizations: A Survey
bibliography.finding: Surveys visualization, interaction and evaluation in immersive analytics.
bibliography.application: Choose VR by analysis task and compare against desktop and slices; benefits are not universal.

hypotheses.claim: Specified edges alter a receiving trajectory under controlled conditions.
hypotheses.test: Same initial state and parameters; remove one edge or a declared set; compare state trajectories.
hypotheses.status: Supported test mechanism exists; effect depends on configuration.

hypotheses.claim: Some couplings change spatial organization beyond isolated execution.
hypotheses.test: Compare gradient, components and persistence across matched seeds; record zero effects too.
hypotheses.status: Explorable with current descriptors; not a universal guarantee.

hypotheses.claim: A macro-description can add useful predictive structure.
hypotheses.test: Define coarse-graining; compare held-out predictors, uncertainty and intervention distributions.
hypotheses.status: Research proposal. G-emergence and effective information are not implemented.

hypotheses.test: Use multiple grid sizes and a defensible scaling range, with boundary and threshold sensitivity controls.
hypotheses.status: Research proposal. No certified fractal dimension from this 10³ prototype.

hypotheses.claim: Immersive inspection improves a particular analysis task.
hypotheses.test: Compare desktop, slices and VR on accuracy, time, accessibility and comfort with participants.
hypotheses.status: Research proposal. Simulated XR tests establish software behavior, not cognitive benefit.

principles.name: The engine stays the engine
principles.text: The binary matrix engine executes declared instructions and exchanges state. The modular workspace sits above it and composes processes through explicit ports. Pages and visualizations expose modules; they do not redefine the engine. Blank-canvas tool composition is the secondary product aim, not a claim that every proposed workspace capability is already implemented.

principles.name: Operational patterns before semantic labels
principles.text: A cell is an indexed state position, not automatically a biological cell. Meaning is an observer hypothesis. Pattern descriptors must not depend on the name or color assigned by an observer.

principles.name: State includes the machinery that changes the bits
principles.text: Write S=(X,R,Q,C): binary cells X, numeric registers R, pending messages Q and relevant clocks C. A recurrence of X alone is not necessarily a recurrence of the whole system.

principles.name: Relations are mechanisms, not decorations
principles.text: For a node i, Sᵢ(t+1)=Fᵢ(Sᵢ(t),Σ Aⱼᵢ·Tⱼᵢ(outputⱼ(t));θᵢ,B,dt). Each engine documents its actual input adapter. A colored connection is evidence only when its delivery and effect can be checked.

principles.name: Emergence is a research question
principles.text: Trajectory divergence, recurrence and visually rich patterns are observations. Weak emergence, causal emergence, intelligence and life are distinct claims requiring their own definitions and tests. Noise is not automatically organized complexity.

principles.name: Boundaries, scale and dimensionality are part of the model
principles.text: A periodic cube, a bounded field, a graph and a tissue are different domains. Three coordinate axes, graph connectivity and visual immersion are different kinds of dimensionality. A 10³ grid cannot establish asymptotic fractality.

principles.name: Purpose belongs to the engineered laboratory
principles.text: The top-level purpose is our reason for building the website, not a goal supposedly possessed by every pattern or by nature. Bottom-up evaluation must check whether the available functions actually support that purpose.

principles.name: The observer is accountable
principles.text: Use matched baselines, disclose thresholds and numerical approximations, preserve failed or trivial outcomes, and keep hypotheses revisable. VR is an optional inspection interface whose value needs user studies, not a source of extra physical validity.

primary.title: Underlying purpose · matrix engine
primary.description: Provide a binary matrix engine that executes declared algorithms, transforms state and exchanges inputs and outputs between connected cube systems.

secondary.title: Secondary aim · modular workspace
secondary.description: Build a modular workspace above the matrix engine: start with a blank canvas, add process modules with explicit inputs and outputs, and connect them into tools for exploring different concepts.

application.title: Applications · exploration and research
application.description: Use composed tools for simulation, feedback control, pattern discovery and reproducible experiments. Emergence is one research question, not a guaranteed result.

purposes.title: Define a bounded system
purposes.question: What exists, and under which assumptions?
leaves: Initial conditions, seed and model scope
purposes.evidence: A run records its rules, initial state, boundary convention and numerical registers.

purposes.title: Generate and transform patterns
purposes.question: What can the rules produce?
purposes.evidence: Rules run, outputs obey their state contract and repeated configurations replay.

purposes.title: Relate processes and regulate flows
purposes.question: What affects what?
purposes.evidence: Enabled edges deliver; disabled edges stop delivery; counterfactuals isolate specified connections.

purposes.title: Observe structure across descriptions
purposes.question: What happened at the chosen scale?
leaves: Measure recurrence, components and spatial change
Offer color, slices, text, 3D and optional VR
purposes.evidence: Descriptors state their topology and scale; views preserve the underlying model state.

purposes.title: Test explanations and revise hypotheses
purposes.question: Which explanation survives a controlled comparison?
leaves: Separate observations, candidate emergence and biological analogy
purposes.evidence: A claim has an explicit intervention, baseline, duration and failure condition.

purposes.title: Preserve, communicate and make knowledge usable
purposes.question: Can someone inspect, repeat and challenge the result?
leaves: Map pages and controls to purpose
Provide accessible controls, references and recoverable navigation
purposes.evidence: Evidence includes provenance; every page and controller action has a purpose allocation.
